units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:15">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> top <he>קָשְׁתָה על דעתך</he> this is difficult according to (not reconcilable with) thy opinion; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:15">ib.</cite> <he>למה א״ל קשתה</he> (not <he>קשתיה</he>) why did he say to him, it is difficult?—V. <cite ref="S02221"><he>קָשֶׁה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: (קִישְּׁתָה, with לילד or without) to have hard labor in travailing.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 4:1">Ḥull. IV, 1</cite> <he>בהמה המְקַשָּׁה לילד וכ׳</he> if an animal is in labor, and &c., v. <cite ref="P00182"><he>עוּבָּר</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 4:4">Nidd. IV, 4</cite> <he>קִשְּׁתָה שלשה וכ׳</he> if she was in pain for three days within eleven days; <cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 5:8">Tosef. ib. V, 8</cite> <cite ref="S01225"><he>קִישֵּׁת</he></cite>, <he>קִשֵּׁת</he>.

<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 5:10">Ib. 10</cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:5">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> <he>שהיו מקשין וכ׳</he>, read: <he>מקישין</he>, v. <cite ref="N01251"><he>נָקַשׁ</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Niddah 13b:3">Nidd. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>המַקְשֶׁה עצמו וכ׳</he> he who causes erection wilfully.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 11:2">Ex. R. s. 11</cite> <he>הרשע הזה ה׳ את לבו וכ׳</he> this wicked (Pharaoh) hardened his heart against the first three signs; a. e.

senses.gloss: to become hard. Y. Pes. VI, 35ᵇ top שסופו להַקְשׁוֹת which gets hard in the course of time.
units: Shebi. II, 10 אם הִקְשׁוּ וכ׳ (Y. ed. a. Bart. הוּקְשׁוּ Hof.) if they became hard (dry) and unfit for man to eat before New Year. (Y. ib. 34ᵃ bot. הקשו a. הוקשו).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 19">Gen. R. s. 19</cite>, opp. <cite ref="T01129"><he>ריתה</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="T01117"><he>רָתָה</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be found hard, distasteful. Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ 5; Num. R. s. 16 ה׳ הדבר והרע וכ׳ the thing was distasteful to and displeased his father.

units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 84">Gen. R. s. 84</cite> <he>נִתְקַשֵּׁת אמו וכ׳</he> his mother was in hard labor at his birth.
<cite ref="Tosefta Niddah 6:4">Tosef. Nidd. VI, 4</cite> <he>משׁיִתְקַשּׁוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="S02256"><he>קִשְׁקֵשׁ</he> I</cite>, a. II.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite>, a. <he>שׁנִתְקַשֵּׁיתָה</he>, v. <cite ref="S02242"><he>קַשְׁיוּת</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to find one’s self in difficulty, to be perplexed, unable to understand or remember.
units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:16">Num. R. s. 15</cite> beg. <he>נ׳ משה במעשה וכ׳</he> Moses found the work of the candlestick more difficult to understand than &c.; <he>כיון שנ׳ אמר וכ׳</he> when he still could not remember it, the Lord said &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:16">Ib.</cite><sup>10</sup>; Tanḥ. B’haʿăl. 6 <he>נִתְקַשֵּׁיתִי לעשותה</he> I could not understand how to do it.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 15:16">Ib.</cite> <he>נ׳ על משה</he> it was too difficult for Moses; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be reluctant, strive against. Tanḥ. Sh’moth 18 כמה נ׳ יונה שלא וכ׳ how hard did Jonah strive not to go on his mission.
units: <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 9:9">Deut. R. s. 9</cite> <he>מִתְקַשֶּׁה כנגדו</he> (the sun) refused to obey; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61">Gen. R. s. 61</cite>; Yalk. Chr. 1073 (play on <cite ref="J00590"><he>יקשן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 25:2">Gen. XXV, 2</cite>) <he>שהיו מִתְקַשִּׁין בעולם</he> they were obnoxious to the world (were hard to deal with); (<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 92:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCII</cite> ed. Bub. <he>שהיו בני אדם קשין</he>).
